title: Two fantastic tours in one day!
text: This was a great tour with some fabulous knowledge about Gaudi, his life and his ideas. This is two separate tours - I didn’t realize when I booked it- which meant we had to taxi to the second sight. Definitely not a deal breaker but good to know. Highly recommend!
author: Meghan_T

title: Marco was amazing!

title: An excellent tour of Sagrada Família and Park Güell
text:
An excellent tour of Sagrada Família and Park Güell, made all the more enjoyable by our guides, Olga E and Paul. Both were very informative, sharing their knowledge with enthusiasm and helping us appreciate Gaudí’s extraordinary architecture and attention to detail.

The guided experience added so much to our understanding and enjoyment of both places. A highlight of our visit to Barcelona—we would highly recommend this tour.
author: Kevin_O

title: Great Tour of Sagrada Familia and Park Guell

author: Samir_G

title: Olga E is amazing
text: Olga E is amazing!  We have had eight tour guides over last ten days and she is far above the rest.  Insight into architecture and design, combined with keen historical facts make this “building” come to life!   She is friendly, uses appropriate humor, helpful and kind.  She was so helpful to me as I’m on oxygen and use a cane.   Far and above any other guide!   Clone her or use her for training!   She is a gem.
author: Ginny_G
